surah.personality_title: Surah Qaf (The Inescapable Reality & The Awakened Heart)
surah.personality_summary: Autonomous Qur'anic surah possessing a distinctive theological axis, spiritual atmosphere, and structural cadence.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Connects opening theme to terminal resolution.
surah.overview: Surah Qaaf (The letter Qaaf) is the 50th surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 45 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡمَجِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ ق ۚ وَالْقُرْآنِ الْمَجِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم ق ۚ والقران المجيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Qaf By the glorious Quran

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: بَلۡ عَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَيۡءٌ عَجِيبٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: بَلْ عَجِبُوا أَنْ جَاءَهُمْ مُنْذِرٌ مِنْهُمْ فَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بل عجبوا ان جاءهم منذر منهم فقال الكافرون هذا شيء عجيب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But the disbelievers are amazed that a warner has come from among them and they say, ‘How strange

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ اۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجۡعُۢ بَعِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَإِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌ بَعِيدٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ااذا متنا وكنا ترابا ۖ ذلك رجع بعيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: To come back [to life] after we have died and become dust? That is too farfetched.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظُۢ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنْقُصُ الْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِنْدَنَا كِتَابٌ حَفِيظٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قد علمنا ما تنقص الارض منهم ۖ وعندنا كتاب حفيظ
ayahs.translation_saheeh: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We know very well what the earth takes away from them: We keep a comprehensive record

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيٓ أَمۡرࣲ مَّرِيجٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا بِالْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِي أَمْرٍ مَرِيجٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: بل كذبوا بالحق لما جاءهم فهم في امر مريج
ayahs.translation_saheeh: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But the disbelievers deny the truth when it comes to them; they are in a state of confusion

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَفَلَمۡ يَنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَيۡفَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَفَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوا إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَاهَا وَزَيَّنَّاهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِنْ فُرُوجٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: افلم ينظروا الى السماء فوقهم كيف بنيناها وزيناها وما لها من فروج
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Do they not see the sky above them––how We have built and adorned it, with no rifts in it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَاهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ بَهِيجٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: والارض مددناها والقينا فيها رواسي وانبتنا فيها من كل زوج بهيج
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: how We spread out the earth and put solid mountains on it, and caused every kind of joyous plant to grow in it

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: تَبۡصِرَةࣰ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبۡدࣲ مُّنِيبࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: تَبْصِرَةً وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُنِيبٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: تبصرة وذكرى لكل عبد منيب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: as a lesson and reminder for every servant who turns to God

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ مُّبَٰرَكࣰ ا فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَحَبَّ ٱلۡحَصِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً مُبَارَكًا فَأَنْبَتْنَا بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ وَحَبَّ الْحَصِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ونزلنا من السماء ماء مباركا فانبتنا به جنات وحب الحصيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and how We send blessed water down from the sky and grow with it gardens, the harvest grain

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱلنَّخۡلَ بَاسِقَٰتࣲ لَّهَا طَلۡعࣱ نَّضِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ لَهَا طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: والنخل باسقات لها طلع نضيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and tall palm trees laden with clusters of dates

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: رِّزۡقࣰ ا لِّلۡعِبَادِۖ وَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةࣰ مَّيۡتࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡخُرُوجُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: رِزْقًا لِلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ الْخُرُوجُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: رزقا للعباد ۖ واحيينا به بلدة ميتا ۚ كذلك الخروج
ayahs.translation_saheeh: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: as a provision for everyone; how with water We give [new] life to a land that is dead? This is how the dead will emerge [from their graves]

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَأَصْحَابُ الرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح واصحاب الرس وثمود
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The people of Noah disbelieved long before these disbelievers, as did the people of Rass, Thamud

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَعَادࣱ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ وَإِخۡوَٰنُ لُوطࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَانُ لُوطٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وعاد وفرعون واخوان لوط
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Ad, Pharaoh, Lot

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ وَقَوۡمُ تُبَّعࣲۚ كُلࣱّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ ۚ كُلٌّ كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واصحاب الايكة وقوم تبع ۚ كل كذب الرسل فحق وعيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the Forest-Dwellers, Tubba: all of these people disbelieved their messengers, and so My warning was realized

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلۡخَلۡقِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي لَبۡسࣲ مِّنۡ خَلۡقࣲ جَدِيدࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَفَعَيِينَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِي لَبْسٍ مِنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: افعيينا بالخلق الاول ۚ بل هم في لبس من خلق جديد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So were We incapable of the first creation? No indeed! Yet they doubt a second creation

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعۡلَمُ مَا تُوَسۡوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفۡسُهُۥۖ وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ حَبۡلِ ٱلۡوَرِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد خلقنا الانسان ونعلم ما توسوس به نفسه ۖ ونحن اقرب اليه من حبل الوريد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We created man––We know what his soul whispers to him: We are closer to him than his jugular vein––

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِذۡ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلۡمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى الْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: اذ يتلقى المتلقيان عن اليمين وعن الشمال قعيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: with two receptors set to record, one on his right side and one on his left

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مَّا يَلۡفِظُ مِن قَوۡلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيۡهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: مَا يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ما يلفظ من قول الا لديه رقيب عتيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: he does not utter a single word without an ever-present watcher

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَجَآءَتۡ سَكۡرَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنۡهُ تَحِيدُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَجَاءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ بِالْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنْتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وجاءت سكرة الموت بالحق ۖ ذلك ما كنت منه تحيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The trance of death will bring the Truth with it: ‘This is what you tried to escape.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْوَعِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ونفخ في الصور ۚ ذلك يوم الوعيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The Trumpet will be sounded: ‘This is the Day [you were] warned of.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَجَآءَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسࣲ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقࣱ وَشَهِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَجَاءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ وَشَهِيدٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وجاءت كل نفس معها سائق وشهيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Each person will arrive attended by an [angel] to drive him on and another to bear witness

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَّقَدۡ كُنتَ فِي غَفۡلَةࣲ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ حَدِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَقَدْ كُنْتَ فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنْكَ غِطَاءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لقد كنت في غفلة من هذا فكشفنا عنك غطاءك فبصرك اليوم حديد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘You paid no attention to this [Day]; but today We have removed your veil and your sight is sharp.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وقال قرينه هذا ما لدي عتيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: The person’s attendant will say, ‘Here is what I have prepared’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: أَلۡقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: أَلْقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: القيا في جهنم كل كفار عنيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘Hurl every obstinate disbeliever into Hell

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مَّنَّاعࣲ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدࣲ مُّرِيبٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: مَنَّاعٍ لِلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ مُرِيبٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: مناع للخير معتد مريب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: everyone who hindered good, was aggressive, caused others to doubt

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلۡقِيَاهُ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: الَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا آخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِي الْعَذَابِ الشَّدِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: الذي جعل مع الله الها اخر فالقياه في العذاب الشديد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and set up other gods alongside God. Hurl him into severe punishment!’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ۞قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطۡغَيۡتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُ رَبَّنَا مَا أَطْغَيْتُهُ وَلَٰكِنْ كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ۞ قال قرينه ربنا ما اطغيته ولكن كان في ضلال بعيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and his [evil] companion will say, ‘Lord, I did not make him transgress; he had already gone far astray himself.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: قَالَ لَا تَخۡتَصِمُواْ لَدَيَّ وَقَدۡ قَدَّمۡتُ إِلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡوَعِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا لَدَيَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُمْ بِالْوَعِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: قال لا تختصموا لدي وقد قدمت اليكم بالوعيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: God will say, ‘Do not argue in My presence. I sent you a warning

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمࣲ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: مَا يُبَدَّلُ الْقَوْلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَا أَنَا بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ما يبدل القول لدي وما انا بظلام للعبيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: and My word cannot be changed: I am not unjust to any creature.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمۡتَلَأۡتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلۡ مِن مَّزِيدࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم نقول لجهنم هل امتلات وتقول هل من مزيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We shall say to Hell on that day, ‘Are you full?’ and it will reply, ‘Are there no more?’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وازلفت الجنة للمتقين غير بعيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: But Paradise will be brought close to the righteous and will no longer be distant

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: هذا ما توعدون لكل اواب حفيظ
ayahs.translation_saheeh: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: ‘This is what you were promised––this is for everyone who turned often to God and kept Him in mind

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: مَّنۡ خَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلۡبࣲ مُّنِيبٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: مَنْ خَشِيَ الرَّحْمَٰنَ بِالْغَيْبِ وَجَاءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُنِيبٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: من خشي الرحمن بالغيب وجاء بقلب منيب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: who held the Most Gracious in awe, though He is unseen, who comes before Him with a heart turned to Him in devotion

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمࣲۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُلُودِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: ادْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُلُودِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ادخلوها بسلام ۖ ذلك يوم الخلود
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: so enter it in peace. This is the Day of everlasting Life.’

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا مَزِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: لهم ما يشاءون فيها ولدينا مزيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will have all that they wish for there, and We have more for them

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشࣰ ا فَنَقَّبُواْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ هَلۡ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا فِي الْبِلَادِ هَلْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: وكم اهلكنا قبلهم من قرن هم اشد منهم بطشا فنقبوا في البلاد هل من محيص
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We have destroyed even mightier generations before these disbelievers, who travelled through [many] lands- was there any escape

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلۡبٌ أَوۡ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ان في ذلك لذكرى لمن كان له قلب او القى السمع وهو شهيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: There truly is a reminder in this for whoever has a heart, whoever listens attentively

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِنْ لُغُوبٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ولقد خلقنا السماوات والارض وما بينهما في ستة ايام وما مسنا من لغوب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We created the heavens, the earth, and everything between, in six Days without tiring

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ ٱلۡغُرُوبِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: فَاصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: فاصبر على ما يقولون وسبح بحمد ربك قبل طلوع الشمس وقبل الغروب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: So [Prophet], bear everything they say with patience; celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising and setting of the sun

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَأَدۡبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَارَ السُّجُودِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: ومن الليل فسبحه وادبار السجود
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: proclaim His praise in the night and at the end of every prayer

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: وَٱسۡتَمِعۡ يَوۡمَ يُنَادِ ٱلۡمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانࣲ قَرِيبࣲ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: وَاسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ مِنْ مَكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
ayahs.arabic_clean: واستمع يوم يناد المناد من مكان قريب
ayahs.translation_saheeh: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: listen out for the Day when the caller will call from a nearby place

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيۡحَةَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُرُوجِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ الْخُرُوجِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم يسمعون الصيحة بالحق ۚ ذلك يوم الخروج
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves]
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: They will come out [from their graves] on that Day, the Day when they hear the mighty blast in reality

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
ayahs.arabic_simple: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا الْمَصِيرُ
ayahs.arabic_clean: انا نحن نحيي ونميت والينا المصير
ayahs.translation_saheeh: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It is We who give life and death; the final return will be to Us

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: يَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ عَنۡهُمۡ سِرَاعࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشۡرٌ عَلَيۡنَا يَسِيرࣱ‏
ayahs.arabic_simple: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ الْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
ayahs.arabic_clean: يوم تشقق الارض عنهم سراعا ۚ ذلك حشر علينا يسير
ayahs.translation_saheeh: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: on the Day when the earth will be torn apart, letting them rush out- that gathering will be easy for Us

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِجَبَّارࣲۖ فَذَكِّرۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_simple: نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِالْقُرْآنِ مَنْ يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.arabic_clean: نحن اعلم بما يقولون ۖ وما انت عليهم بجبار ۖ فذكر بالقران من يخاف وعيد
ayahs.translation_saheeh: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: We know best what the disbelievers say. You [Prophet] are not there to force them, so remind, with this Quran, those who fear My warning
